title: Web Security for Freshers
intro: Web security (fresher level) introduces the threats every web developer must know. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with authentication vs authorization (the two concerns), then HTTPS and TLS (the transport security), then password hashing (the storage security). The injection family — SQL injection and XSS — follows at the attack tier, then CSRF. JWT and the OWASP Top 10 overview close the module at the awareness tier.
